notes:
GeekClaw v5.0.26 - Channel Plugin Foundations (WhatsApp / LINE / Email)

New backend channel plugins (Rust, in nomifun-channel):
- WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta Business): webhook inbound + REST send. Credentials
  are phone_number_id + whatsapp_access_token + verify_token + whatsapp_app_secret.
  HMAC-SHA256 X-Hub-Signature-256 verification is wired in.
- LINE Messaging API: webhook inbound + REST push. Credentials are channel_id +
  channel_access_token + channel_secret. HMAC base64 X-Line-Signature
  verification is wired in.
- Email (IMAP inbound + SMTP outbound, via lettre/async-imap). Credentials are
  account_id (the From address) + imap_username + imap_password; imap_host /
  smtp_host auto-resolved for gmail/outlook/qq/163/126 addresses when left
  blank. SMTP send is fully wired; IMAP IDLE polling is a no-op stub in this
  release — see IMAP_INBOUND_TODO in plugins/email/plugin.rs and the 5.0.27
  roadmap.

Notes
- Frontend channel-center UI for the three new platforms lands in 5.0.27.
  Until then, the plugins are reachable via the REST API but not from the
  channel settings page; the bot type is exposed in the Rust
  `PluginType` enum and the JSON `type` column.
- The `wecom` long-connection bot is the supported corporate path for now;
  a follow-up adds `wecom` image / news message types in 5.0.27.
- Channel webhook HTTP routes for the new platforms (WhatsApp / LINE) are
  scheduled for 5.0.27 alongside the IMAP IDLE work.

Compatibility
- Existing channel plugins (telegram / lark / dingtalk / weixin / wecom /
  discord / slack / matrix / mattermost / twitch / nostr / qqbot) are
  unaffected. PluginType new variants default to ConversationSource::GeekClaw.
